risks.title: Merger failure
risks.score_rationale: This risk is mentioned first in the Risks Related to the Merger section. The language used is strong (materially adversely affected, lose all or part of your investment). Merger failure could result in significant termination costs and negatively impact stock price and operations.

risks.title: Inaccuracy of actuarial assumptions
risks.score_rationale: This risk is detailed in the Risks Related to Our Business section and is fundamental to the company's business model. The language (materially adverse effect, impair our solvency) indicates high severity. This is a recurring risk for insurers.

risks.title: Annuity product guarantees
risks.score_rationale: This risk is well explained in the Risks Related to Our Business section and concerns specific products. The potential impact on results, capital and solvency is clearly stated (material adverse effect, ultimately impact our solvency).

risks.title: Hedge strategy ineffectiveness
risks.score_rationale: This risk is addressed in the Risks Related to Our Business section and concerns management of market risks. The text emphasizes that the strategy may not be fully effective and can result in significant volatility in our profitability measures.

risks.title: Business restrictions during merger
risks.score_rationale: This risk is mentioned in the Risks Related to the Merger section. It describes limitations on business actions prior to merger completion (adversely affect our ability to execute certain of our business strategies).

risks.title: Merger-related litigation
risks.score_rationale: This risk is identified in the Risks Related to the Merger section. The mention of complaints and demand letters, as well as potential for future litigation (could result in significant costs and divert management's attention), justifies its classification.

risks.title: Impact of economic conditions
risks.score_rationale: This risk is mentioned in the Economic Environment and Capital Markets-Related Risks section. Unfavorable economic conditions can affect policy persistence and asset valuation.
